description.text:
The ninth and last POP Series set, 17 cards Pokémon Organized Play gave out in packs at its leagues and tournaments from March to September 2009.

Every card in the packs is non-holo. Holo copies came later in shop products: Rotom as a cracked ice holo in Rising Rivals blisters (May 2009), Manaphy, Regigigas and a cracked ice reverse holo Raichu in Supreme Victors blisters (August 2009), and Lopunny in Arceus blisters (November 2009). Pikachu also came with a Pokémon Day 2009 stamp, at Pokémon Day in the Netherlands, and in German at Germany's Pokémon Day the same year.

It isn't found in POP Series 9 packs, which held only non-holo copies of the set's rares.
